newsitem.title: USA: Chile seeks 960,000 barrels of crude for mid-March.
newsitem.headline: Chile seeks 960,000 barrels of crude for mid-March.

text.p: Chile's state-owned oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) is seeking to buy 960,000 barrels of crude oil for delivery March 16-20, traders said on Tuesday.
The tender will be awarded tomorrow, traders said.
ENAP purchased one cargo each of Ecuadoran Oriente and Nigerian Forcados in its last purchase tender for delivery March 5-10.
Separately, Uruguay's state-owned oil company ANCAP plans to award a crude tender tomorrow for one million barrels of crude.
